description: Fifteen verified stories from September 27: the lingering nor'easter, October 1 SNAP changes, consumer sentiment near a record low, tech layoffs past 225,000, near-record California gas prices, record Phoenix homebuilder incentives, the attorney general's defense of the CNN pool exclusion, a third taxpayer-funded White House ad, the U.S. urging China on fentanyl precursors, OpenAI's training halt and Gates's call for AI law, the $387.5 million Bitget hack, two mass shootings in South Africa, five arrests near RAF Fairford, Hurricanes Nolo and Polo, and deadly flooding across India, Nepal, and Thailand. Facts only, no spin.
title: Unspun — September 28, 2026
